desc.testo: NatWest Group plc, formerly The Royal Bank of Scotland Group plc, is a British banking and insurance holding company, based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It operates a variety of banking brands offering personal and business banking, private banking, investment banking, insurance and corporate finance.
desc.trad: NatWest Group plc, già The Royal Bank of Scotland Group plc, è una holding bancaria e assicurativa britannica, con sede a Edimburgo, in Scozia. Gestisce una varietà di marchi bancari che offrono servizi bancari personali e aziendali, private banking, investment banking, assicurazioni e finanza aziendale.
